faq_heading: New construction in Port Moody: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Port Moody where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Port Moody?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were condos in Port Moody Centre: median build year 2012, 195 sales, median price $705,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Port Moody?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was duplexes in Heritage Woods PM: 9 days to sell at a median, closing at 98.0% of the list price.

blocks.text: What you see above is a live MLS® search for Port Moody: active houses, townhomes and condos with an age of 0 or less in the board's records, so this year's completions and homes still being built. Land and income properties do not appear. Presales are often sold by the developer's own team and reach the MLS® only near completion, so this search will not show every project that is selling.
What newer homes in Port Moody have sold for
Looking at November 2025 to October 2026, Port Moody Centre had the newest sold condos in Port Moody, built in 2012 at the median, with 195 sales at a median of $705,000.

None of the 17 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later, so most of what sold was older stock; newer homes here are mostly first sales that never reach the resale shelf.

items.t: Port Moody Centre condos: 195 sold at a median of $705,000 (middle half between $602,000 and $797,000), taking 26 days at 97.7% of the list price, with a median build year of 2012. The typical home had 2 bedrooms, it sold for about $809 per square foot, strata fees were a median $459 a month and 3% of the sales closed over the list price. The median moved from $690,000 (November to January) to $711,000 (August to October).

blocks.text: Port Moody overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across Port Moody, 111 houses sold at a median of $1,870,000, with the middle half between $1,610,000 and $2,200,000. They took 23 days and closed at 96.6% of the list price, and the median build year was 1992. The typical house sat on a lot of about 6,943 square feet. The median moved from $1,939,000 (November to January) to $1,765,000 (August to October).

Port Moody townhomes over the past year: 111 sales, a median of $945,000, and a middle half from $826,000 to $1,179,000. The median home was built in 1992, took 18 days to sell and closed at 98.0% of list. Strata fees were a median $479 a month. The median moved from $940,000 (November to January) to $860,000 (August to October).

Across Port Moody, 243 condos sold at a median of $705,000, with the middle half between $605,000 and $799,450. They took 26 days and closed at 97.7% of the list price, and the median build year was 2008. Strata fees were a median $466 a month. The median held near $700,000 from the first quarter to the last.
